# Bulbine latifolia (L.f.) Spreng.

First published in Syst. Veg., ed. 16. 2: 86 (1825)

This species is accepted

The native range of this species is S. Tropical & S. Africa. It is a succulent perennial and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.
